req.title: Honour Accept: application/json
req.statement: The system shall respect an Accept: application/json request header by serialising responses as JSON.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that when a client sends Accept: application/json, the server must respond with JSON-serialised content. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — standard GET /get with Accept: application/json yields 200 and valid JSON with correct Content-Type; (2) positive EP — POST /post with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON; (3) positive EP — GET /headers with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON containing the Accept header; (4) negative NEG — GET /get without Accept header still returns JSON (httpbin always returns JSON, so we verify the Content-Type is still application/json); (5) boundary BVA — Accept header with quality factor q=1.0 (maximum) for application/json; (6) boundary BVA — Accept header listing application/json alongside other types (content negotiation picks JSON); (7) DT — multiple endpoints (PUT, PATCH, DELETE) all honour Accept: application/json; (8) NEG — verifying the Content-Type header value is exactly 'application/json' not a superset or different type. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 not >=200), exact Content-Type strings, and exact JSON key presence.

tests.name: test_get_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /get endpoint is available
actions: Send GET /get with Accept: application/json header
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, headers, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got {ct}'
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body

test_get_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_post_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
POST /post endpoint is available
actions: Send POST /post with Accept: application/json and a form body
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_post_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post(
        '/post',
        data={'key': 'value'},
        headers={'Accept': 'application/json'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got {ct}'
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in body, f'Missing key: {key}'

test_post_with_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type()

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_headers_endpoint_with_accept_json_reflects_accept_header():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})

tests.name: test_put_patch_delete_with_accept_json_all_return_json
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
PUT /put, PATCH /patch, DELETE /delete endpoints are available
expected: All three responses have HTTP status code exactly 200
All three Content-Type headers start with application/json
All three response bodies are valid JSON with expected keys
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_put_patch_delete_with_accept_json_all_return_json():
    client = app.test_client()
    headers = {'Accept': 'application/json'}
    expected_keys = ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json')
    for method, path in [('PUT', '/put'), ('PATCH', '/patch'), ('DELETE', '/delete')]:
        r = client.open(path, method=method, headers=headers)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {path} returned {r.status_code}'
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'{method} {path} Content-Type: {ct}'
        body = json.loads(r.data)
        for key in expected_keys:
            assert key in body, f'{method} {path} missing key: {key}'

test_put_patch_delete_with_accept_json_all_return_json()

tests.name: test_content_type_is_exactly_application_json_not_text_html
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /get endpoint is available
expected: Status code is exactly 200 not 4xx or 5xx
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_content_type_is_exactly_application_json_not_text_html():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert not ct.startswith('text/html'), f'Got text/html instead of application/json'
    assert not ct.startswith('text/plain'), f'Got text/plain instead of application/json'
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got: {ct}'
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert len(body) > 0

test_content_type_is_exactly_application_json_not_text_html()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_success_with_accept_json_returns_json
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> endpoint is available
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with valid Basic auth and Accept: application/json
expected: JSON body contains authenticated=True and user='user'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
import base64

def test_basic_auth_success_with_accept_json_returns_json():
    client = app.test_client()
    credentials = base64.b64encode(b'user:passwd').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/passwd',
        headers={
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got {ct}'
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body.get('authenticated') == True
    assert body.get('user') == 'user'

test_basic_auth_success_with_accept_json_returns_json()
